Resolves #21482

🧭 *Unattended `buildScripts` calls with missing flags now fail immediately with the exact CLI invocation instead of blocking forever on `inquirer.prompt`.*

Generalizes `buildScripts/create/theme.mjs`'s non-TTY check into `buildScripts/util/assertInteractivePrompt.mjs` (`theme.mjs` retains its inline check, as #21482 allows) and wires it ahead of every `inquirer.prompt` and filesystem write across all eight interactive `buildScripts` entrypoints (`build/all.mjs`, `build/themes.mjs`, `webpack/buildThreads.mjs`, `create/addConfig.mjs`, `create/app.mjs`, `create/appMinimal.mjs`, `create/class.mjs`, and `create/component.mjs`), while skipping `inquirer.prompt([])` when flags already resolve every question.

Evidence: L2 (Playwright unit specs spawning real non-TTY child processes against isolated workspace fixtures, directory-snapshot write-absence checks, and `check-package-contents` tarball validation) → L2 required (AC-1..AC-7). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `buildScripts/util/assertInteractivePrompt.mjs` + direct unit arm in `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/assertInteractivePrompt.spec.mjs` |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: `assertInteractivePrompt.spec.mjs` spawns all 8 `buildscripts-noninteractive-inquirer` scripts on non-TTY `stdio: 'pipe'` (including partial companion-flag cases on `create/class.mjs` and `create/component.mjs`), asserting non-zero exit without timeout, exact CLI flag hints, and unchanged directory snapshots |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: `assertInteractivePrompt.spec.mjs` (`isTTY: true` unit arm, explicit-flag CLI execution arm, and non-view base arm on `create/component.mjs` without `-C`/`-p`) and existing `createTheme.spec.mjs`, `createApp.spec.mjs`, and `createClassModelStore.spec.mjs` suites |
| AC-4 | CI-covered: `WATCH_THEMES_HELP` + `--help` / `-h` handling in `buildScripts/helpers/watchThemes.mjs`, pinned in `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/helpers/watchThemes.spec.mjs` |
| AC-5 | Outside-CI consumer census (below): `neo-cc` (`package.json` `bin.neo-cc` → `./buildScripts/create/class.mjs`) is guarded directly here; `neomjs/create-app` `tasks/createPackageJson.mjs` delegates generated workspace scripts to `node_modules/neo.mjs/buildScripts/...`, and uncovered `tasks/neo-app.mjs:179` is filed as neomjs/create-app#79 |

## Deltas from ticket

- **`buildScripts/build/all.mjs:87`:** Fixed a pre-existing copy-paste check where the `themes` prompt tested `!programOpts.npminstall` instead of `!programOpts.themes`, ensuring `-t` is accurately recognized as missing or supplied during flag-driven runs.
- **`buildScripts/create/component.mjs`:** Added `-C, --createController` and `-p, --createStateProvider` (required on non-TTY only when `isViewBaseClass(programOpts.baseClass)` holds outside framework `src/`), forwarded them to `./buildScripts/create/class.mjs`, and gated the trailing `fileServer.mjs --open` launch on `process.stdin.isTTY`.
- **`test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/buildDependencyResolution.spec.mjs:30`:** Included `util/assertInteractivePrompt.mjs` in the synthetic `installedEngine/buildScripts` copy list alongside `util/buildId.mjs` and `util/sanitizer.mjs`.
- **Consumer Census (`AC-5`):**
  - `neo-cc`: `package.json` maps `"neo-cc": "./buildScripts/create/class.mjs"` — covered directly by this PR (including upfront companion checks for `-M`, `-m`, `-C`, and `-p` prior to `createClass()`).
  - `neomjs/create-app`: `tasks/createPackageJson.mjs` (`lines 19–37`) wires generated workspace scripts (`add-config`, `build-all-questions`, `build-themes`, `build-threads`, `create-app`, `create-app-minimal`, `create-class`, `create-component`) to `./node_modules/neo.mjs/buildScripts/...`, inheriting this guard on Engine 14; `tasks/neo-app.mjs` (`line 179`) still invokes `inquirer.prompt(questions)` without `!process.stdin.isTTY` and is tracked in neomjs/create-app#79.

## Test Evidence

Diagonal proof: prior to `assertInteractivePrompt`, spawning `node buildScripts/build/themes.mjs -f` or `node buildScripts/create/class.mjs -c MyApp.view.Dashboard -b container.Base -n no` on non-TTY `stdio: 'pipe'` timed out waiting on `inquirer.prompt` (and `create/class.mjs` wrote `Dashboard.mjs` before hanging on `createController`); all 12 non-TTY omitted-flag cases in `assertInteractivePrompt.spec.mjs` now exit non-zero in `<100ms` with zero filesystem mutations, and non-view bases on `create/component.mjs` (`core.Base`, `controller.Component`, `state.Provider`) succeed without `-C` or `-p`. `agent-preflight`: not hosted in `neomjs/neo`; local `check-package-contents`, `check-file-sizes`, `check-relative-links`, and `neo-agent-skills-pr-body` passed.

### 🧭 Patch-Blind Premise Snapshot

*   **Inputs Read Before Patch:** #21482 (design authority: the graduation of Discussion #21469, verified on the Discussion), the changed-file list, the `dev` source of all eight prompt sites with their conditions and the write sites after them (`class.mjs` `createClass` → `mkdirpSync`/`writeFileSync`), the `theme.mjs` precedent, and the `package.json` script map.
